children: Caring Brands completed an initial $4.6 million closing of a $9.0 million private placement to fund salesforce and marketing launches.
Completed initial closing of $4.6M in convertible preferred shares under a $9.0M purchase agreement.
An additional $4.4M of subscriptions executed; funds expected to clear and trigger issuance of preferred shares and warrants.
Proceeds will be used to launch domestic and international marketing campaigns and build a proprietary salesforce.
Company warned additional closings are subject to conditions and not guaranteed to occur as planned.
